checks.name: serve
checks.runbook: maxpm serve runs the page, the relay, every pass of the loop (sessions, reviews, deploys, notices) and the other checks; when it is down, no session starts. The watchdog runs this check with no serve, and its repair (maxpm serve --kick) restarts serve through its login agent, launchd or systemd (maxpm serve --install-login, or the desktop app's Keep MaximizePM running in the background), or stops the serve of the open desktop app, which starts it again. With no login agent and the app closed, the person stopped serve on purpose: the watchdog runs this check not at all. Read $MAXPM_QUEUE_DIR/serve.log (launchd's output of serve) and serve-loop.json (the last pass and its error). A loop that is late with a port that answers: a pass hangs; read locked.log for a lock held long.

checks.name: relay
checks.runbook: The relay carries the page to the person's phone. It runs inside maxpm serve and reconnects by itself; this check fails after 5 minutes not connected. relay-state.json beside the queue has the state and the last error. An error that names the token or the plan needs the person (maxpm connect, the account page); a network error heals by itself, and the repair restarts serve once the fault holds.

checks.name: idle-work
checks.runbook: Ready agent work and no live session for ops_idle_work. Read maxpm capacity, maxpm who and the setting max_sessions; a launch that fails shows in the serve log and in the agent's pane.

checks.name: stuck-session
checks.runbook: A session holds an item and reported nothing for activity_silence. Read its pane (maxpm view), its last commands (maxpm show <item>), and whether it waits on a prompt or a permission.

checks.name: lease-loop
checks.runbook: An item whose lease ran out ops_lease_loop times: sessions take it and stop. Read its history (maxpm show <item>) and the panes of the sessions that held it; the item may need a split or a person.

checks.name: release-loop
checks.runbook: An item released or reopened ops_release_loop times: each session finds the same blocker. Read the release notes in its history and link the blocker (maxpm dep) or ask the person.

checks.name: notices
checks.runbook: The newest notice of a channel failed, so the person gets nothing on it. maxpm notify status shows each channel and its last error; maxpm notify test <channel> sends one. A Mac channel with 'Notifications are turned off' needs the person's setting.

checks.name: serve-errors
checks.runbook: New exceptions in serve.log (the last line of each traceback). A page that closed its connection (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError) does not count. 'database is locked' is a write that waited too long: locked.log names the holder.

checks.name: locked
checks.runbook: Commands that gave up on the queue's write lock ('database is locked'). The held= lines of locked.log name the transactions that held the lock 2 s or longer: find the function that holds it long.

checks.name: page-speed
checks.runbook: The page's state builds of maxpm serve are slow: the p90 of the last 50 is over 100 ms (a warning) or 200 ms (critical); every page action must answer in under 100 ms. GET /api/state-timing on serve_port lists the builds with their parts (start, state, goals, terminals, sessions), CPU and wait; GET /api/state-timing?profile=1 samples the next build and lists its slowest lines and what the other threads of serve did. A part much slower than its CPU waits (a subprocess, the interpreter lock, the disk).
